g.text: A sinusoid is the real projection of a rotating complex vector

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Cosine convention with RMS phasor magnitude. The phasor V is constant; multiplying by e^(jωt) gives the rotating vector. The time-domain peak is √2 times
the phasor magnitude. Projection here is normalized in the complex-plane sketch.
